limitations: 2022 baseline is a direct NCSBE precinct/method source rebuild, not a scaled correction to the prior research snapshot. Every actual real and administrative precinct row is counted once according to the official layout. All32 independent FEC candidate/write-in controls reconcile.

Write-In(Miscellaneous) remains a source-reported aggregate Other category; no named-person or major-party allocation is inferred. The separately named DianaR.Jimison write-in is retained independently.

2026 all39 county→district candidate controls reconcile the exact registered official-attributed snapshot. An ordinary current dashboardHTML request succeeded, but no fresh primary county vector was qualified; this is same-extract reconciliation, not independently refreshed current counts.
Blank source-update times remain null; asOf is explicitly the registered extract retrieval-time reference, not an invented count-update time. All current counts stay unofficial/provisional.

Complete100-county inventories and actual per-year portions are independently matched to the Census roster; district intersections differ. No same-seat/candidate or every-minor-county-boundary-change assertion.

Candidate-vote sums are not ballots cast, distinct voters or eligible-voter turnout. Different districts/nominees/field sizes, rules and provisional counting constrain statistical interpretation; flags cannot establish wrongdoing.
